scope: Post-hoc audit of returned top-10 predictions on S01E03/S01E04; separate from the frozen positive-control recall experiment
selection: Returned array positions 0 through 9 for each version, without cherry-picking based on score or appearance
reviewer: Assistant temporal visual inspection; no independent human confirmation
imagePolicy: Scores and classifier labels hidden on review sheets; actual source times retained; predictions and version identity are not fully blinded

grades.2: Comparable observed action trajectory or distinctive sustained posture; sufficient visible support on the matched tracks
grades.1: Weak/generic posture similarity, isolated gaze similarity, or a returning camera with substantially unchanged pose; some similarity but limited montage specificity
grades.0: Observed incompatible action/posture, non-person artifact, or clear wrong-track association without comparable evidence
grades.unknown: Insufficient visibility or temporal evidence; resolve by dense sequence and native pose overlay if possible, otherwise retain unknown

specialCases.allPeople: Different people may form a relevant parallel; do not demand identity equality
specialCases.headOnly: Judge head evidence separately; do not infer whole-body correspondence
specialCases.static: A distinctive observed held posture is eligible; neutral standing/sitting alone is weak
specialCases.mirroring: Mirrored actions may be relevant because the frozen benchmark enables mirror invariance
specialCases.occlusion: Missing evidence is unknown, not automatically a false positive
specialCases.duplicates: Track returning-camera/near-duplicate concerns separately from exact duplicate record invariants

metrics.strictPrecisionAt10: Grade 2 count / 10, with unknown treated as unresolved; report lower/upper bounds [grade2/10,(grade2+unknown)/10]
metrics.lenientPrecisionAt10: Grades 1+2 count / 10, with corresponding unknown bounds
metrics.disclosure: Do not call top-10 precision episode-wide Precision, independent ground truth, confidence calibration, or a representative random-sample estimate

noTuning: Do not adjust matcher thresholds or logic from these held-out prediction judgments; implementation changes must use the tuning split or another previously reserved dataset
